1806-9339482026Revista brasileira de ginecologia e obstetricia : revista da Federacao Brasileira das Sociedades de Ginecologia e ObstetriciaRev Bras Ginecol ObstetPreeclampsia Risk in Obese Pregnant Women without Diabetes Mellitus: a Meta-Analysis Comparing Metformin versus Control Group.e-rbgo4610.61622/rbgo/2026rbgo46To evaluate the impact of metformin on reducing the risk of pre-eclampsia in obese pregnant women without diabetes.Following PRISMA guidelines, Scopus, Embase, PubMed (MEDLINE), Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, LILACS, SciElo, and Web of Science were searched for articles published between 2014 and April 2024. Search terms: ("Metformin" OR "Biguanide" OR "Glucophage" OR "dimethylbiguanide") AND ("pre-eclampsia" OR "preeclampsia") AND ("obese pregnant women" OR "obesity in pregnancy" OR "maternal obesity" OR "pregnancy" OR "obesity").From 2022 studies identified, three randomized controlled trials comparing metformin with placebo or standard care in obese pregnant women without diabetes were included. Primary outcomes were pre-eclampsia incidence; secondary outcomes included gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes, preterm birth, cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and NICU admission.Data were extracted, and odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated. Heterogeneity was assessed using I2 statistics.Metformin did not significantly reduce PE risk (OR: 0.42; 95% CI: 0.10-1.68; p=0.22; I2=81%). Secondary outcomes showed no significant differences. Subgroup analysis excluding a methodological outlier suggested potential benefit (OR: 0.20; 95% CI: 0.10-0.38; p<0.00001; I2=0%). Metformin alone may not effectively prevent PE in these women, but efficacy could improve with lifestyle modifications. Study heterogeneity highlights the need for larger, rigorous trials.Metformin should not be routinely recommended for pre-eclampsia prevention in obese pregnant women without diabetes until robust evidence from further research supports its efficacy.Prospero registry: CRD42024611538.LopesBianca CardosoBC0000-0001-8619-1749Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto Medical School Minas Gerais Brasil Medical School, Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto, Ouro Preto - Minas Gerais.
